messages:
maria (ML): quick heads-up: q4b-int4 looks fine on short tests but we see regression on our longform summarization holdouts (8k+). ROUGE down ~0.06, hallucination rate up. :frowning:
sam: do we have repros? paste one anonymized example pls
maria (ML): sanitized snippet:
```
SRC: <8k_article>
REF: 5-bullet factual summary
Q4B: invents an extra event and wrong year
Q8: closer to ref
```
Also noticed attention memory jumps around 3.5k tokens.
kevin: runtime note 1: kv_compact heuristic was enabled on canary for int4 (threshold=0.55). could be evicting important KV state early.
dina: we should expand golden long anchors. current long golds <200. propose collect 600 candidates across news/legal/medical; dedupe -> ~300 final golds.
kevin: dedupe plan: shingle Jaccard >0.58 OR embed cosine >=0.90 => dup. then span-overlap check and 2% manual spotcheck.
labeler-bot: queued 600 tasks to labeler/long-golden-candidates (ETA 72h) :robot_face:
sam: will run a canary matrix: q8 vs q4b-int4 x kv_compact true/false. script: `./canary.sh --models q8,q4b-int4 --flags kv_compact=true,false --prompts long_cands.csv --metrics rouge,hallucination_score`
maria (ML): alert thresholds: if median_rouge delta <= -0.05 or halluc_rate delta >= +0.03, revert runtime change on canary and pause rollout.
dina: labeler rubric: 1) factual errors flagged, 2) unsupported assertions highlighted, 3) missing key facts noted. two-pass review.
kevin: after dedupe expected ~360 unique, will push to labeling queue.
sam: I'll include an arm that changes only runtime (no model quant) to isolate cause. starting runs tonight.
maria (ML): add 3 synthetic multi-hop prompts to catch hallucination patterns earlier. tracker: https://redwood.company/s/ops/int4-long-summ (private).
kevin: timeline: dedupe+prep today, labelers start tomorrow, canary runs tomorrow PM, preliminary Thu AM.
maria (ML): thanks all 1 let's aim to ship a golden refresh + either runtime toggle or model patch by EOW. :thumbsup:
